name: v26_option_forward_iv_term_structure
hypothesis: A positive medium-minus-short option forward slope combined with lower near-term IV stress may capture option-market expectations without reusing breakeven+dilution.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(forward_price_180 / close - forward_price_30 / close, 60), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_30 - implied_volatility_mean_180), 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry)
notes: Option term-structure channel; no share-count, no close/open parent, strict corr gate against QPa7KOGK and 0m7p1Lb1.

name: v26_option_vol_term_structure_breadth
hypothesis: Lower short-term implied-volatility stress relative to longer maturities may identify stocks with cleaner near-term risk pricing; partner breadth stabilizes coverage.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_10 - implied_volatility_mean_120), 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (historical_volatility_10 - historical_volatility_120), 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry)
notes: Tests option volatility term structure rather than skew or breakeven spread.

name: v26_order_backlog_growth_quality
hypothesis: Growing order backlog relative to assets, when paired with sales growth and partner breadth, may indicate future revenue visibility distinct from deferred revenue.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(vec_avg(fnd6_obs), 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales_growth, 126), subindustry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry)
notes: Uses vector order backlog via vec_avg; compare carefully to RRp7Q9Le deferred-revenue active.

name: v26_legal_sentiment_settlement_clean
hypothesis: Positive legal-news sentiment and low legal-settlement payments may proxy lower litigation overhang without relying on accounting-pressure fields.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_legal, 60), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * legal_settlement_payment_amount / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry)
notes: Non-earnings news branch with a sparse but interpretable legal settlement anchor.

name: v26_labor_sentiment_benefit_burden
hypothesis: Positive labor-news sentiment with lower employee-benefit liability burden may identify firms with fewer labor-cost overhangs.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_labor, 60), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * employee_compensation_benefit_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry)
notes: Labor/news channel; benefit liability is auxiliary, not a pw6jz8ob-style accounting-pressure rescue.

name: v26_credit_rating_capacity
hypothesis: Positive credit-rating news plus unused credit capacity may capture financing flexibility distinct from leverage and tax/prepaid accounting pressure.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_credit_ratings, 60), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank((credit_facility_remaining_capacity - credit_facility_outstanding_balance) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_comp, 126), industry)
notes: Credit-news/capacity channel; expected sparse coverage, submit only if weight and sub-universe checks pass.

name: v26_analyst_recommendation_upgrade
hypothesis: Better current analyst recommendations and recent recommendation upgrades may predict returns through a channel different from EPS yield.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(anl4_eaz2lrec_ratingvalue), 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(vec_avg(anl4_eaz2lrec_ratingvalue), 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry)
notes: Analyst recommendation vector converted with vec_avg; strict corr gate against akd1nQMW and RRpm5LEo.

name: v26_relationship_breadth_residual
hypothesis: Broad product-overlap relationships in excess of direct competitor count may represent ecosystem breadth rather than competitor centrality.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_all - rel_num_comp, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry)
notes: Relationship breadth residual; avoids customer authority/page-rank near-neighbors and uses competitor return only as a small timing term.
